read: Adoption of the wrong senior seed under real-time intervention: no intervention 0.7583, a soft monitor warning 0.725, a hard in-line private-answer-first monitor 0.75. Prevention (the drop from baseline) is 0.0333 soft and 0.0083 hard. This complements detection: the deployable referee catches essentially all adoptions after the fact (recall approx 1.0), while a real-time monitor prevents a substantial share before the holdout commits, so prevention and detection are stackable oversight layers rather than substitutes. Paired McNemars test each intervention against no intervention.
